phases.objective: Convert one complete no-secret eight-family source snapshot capture into deterministic repository source-document candidates and a review index without producing a dispatch-ready manifest or executing any live operation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A previously captured array of eight canonical authority source snapshots
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Eight deterministic bounded repository source candidates and one review-required index are validated or written, while blob binding, T001/T002 closure, migration authority, and all runtime effects remain false.
steps: Load a source snapshot array directly or from snapshots, sources, or source_bundle.sources.
Require exactly one snapshot for every registered authority evidence family.
Validate complete pagination, bounded records, timestamps, evidence references, and explicit no-effect/no-secret safety markers.
Reject sensitive values, duplicate or missing families, unsafe output paths, excessive records, and source documents above 8 MiB.
Render deterministic repository source documents with capture metadata and records hashes.
Build a candidate index with paths, content hashes, record counts, and capture timestamps.
Keep the candidate index review-required and explicitly not dispatch-ready because Git blob binding must occur after source-document commit review.
Perform no write unless the caller explicitly supplies --write.
assertions: Exactly eight deterministic source documents are produced.
No source document or index contains blob_sha or the final repository manifest contract.
Dry-run mode creates no repository files.
Write mode keeps every output within the repository root and the index within the source directory.
T001 and T002 remain open and migration_apply_authorized remains false.
No live workflow, SQL, database/provider mutation, credential payload read, external write, deployment, Production promotion, runtime authority change, or task closure occurs.

phases.objective: Run an explicitly authorized read-only source capture, review and merge the generated source documents, then finalize a separate reviewed ancestor and Git blob-bound manifest.
